Application stands disposed of.

CRL.M.C. 160/2024, CRL.M.A. Nos.667-668/2024 Petition has been preferred on behalf of the petitioner under Section 482 Cr.P.C for quashing of FIR No. 0027/2021 under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC registered at P.S.: Palam Village, Delhi as well as proceedings arising out of the said FIR in Criminal Case No.2620/2023 pending before learned MM, South West District, Dwarka Courts, New Delhi.

sentences.text: Issue notice.

1 co-accused in the same FIR, through all permissible modes on necessary steps being taken by the petitioner.
Status report / reply be filed within four weeks with an advance copy to learned counsel for the petitioner.

Learned Senior Counsel for the petitioner submits that the marriage between respondent No.2/complainant and respondent No.3 was solemnized on 23.07.2000 and the petitioner who is the sister-in-law of respondent No.2 has been living in USA since 2001 and is a doctor by profession.
It is submitted that the allegations levelled against the petitioner pertain to the period 2001-2002 after the inception of marriage.

Reliance is further placed upon Geeta Mehrotra v. State of Uttar Pradesh, 2012 (9) SCR 641; Kahkashan Kausar @ Sonam & Ors. v. State of Bihar & Ors., 2022 (6)
SCC 599; XXXX v. XXXX & Ors., Criminal Appeal No.416/2020, decided on 24.04.2020; and Mahalakshmi & Ors. v. The State of Karnataka & Anr., Criminal Appeal No.494/2023, decided on 30.11.2023;

sentences.text: Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, learned trial court is directed to exempt the presence of the petitioner on the next date of hearing fixed before the court.

Since learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is willing to join the proceedings through virtual mode,
she is permitted to join the proceedings through V.C. on the next date of hearing.
ANOOP KUMAR MENDIRATTA, J JANUARY 11, 2024/v
